item.title: Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia after suspected sabotage plot on drone maker
item.description: Estonia will close all its border crossing points with Russia from December 1, its ​foreign minister ‌said on Sunday, following a suspected ⁠sabotage attack on an Estonian defence company that Tallinn blamed on ‌Moscow. Publicado también por: France 24 - English. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
item.dc:creator: BY REUTERS

item.title: "No hay palabras para este descalabro": miles de jubilados siguen afectados por la crisis de Ueno Bank en Paraguay
item.description: El Banco Central de Paraguay asegura que ha devuelto los depósitos garantizados a más de 1,8 millones de clientes de Ueno Bank. Sin embargo, todavía debe resolver el destino de los fondos de cinco cajas de jubilaciones y de miles de inversores. Mientras tanto, los bancos privados reciben a los antiguos usuarios de la entidad intervenida. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Maxime Pluvinet

item.description: Tres de los sospechosos están presuntamente relacionados con la detención ilegal y el asesinato del documentalista lituano Mantas Kvedaravicius en la ciudad ucraniana de Mariúpol Leer Fuente: El Mundo - Internacional.

item.title: Latest news bulletin | November 15th, 2026 – Evening
item.description: Catch up with the most important stories from around Europe and beyond this November 15th, 2026 - latest news, breaking news, World, Business, Entertainment, Politics, Culture, Travel. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: How did over 2,000 migrants reach the Canaries in just 48 hours?
item.description: Spain says nearly 2,200 migrants have arrived by boat to the Canary Islands this weekend. The strip of the Atlantic Ocean between West Africa and the Canary Islands is one of the world's deadliest migration routes – and the journey is usually made with ill-equipped dinghies and overcrowded boats. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Madrid, Sarah Morris. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Estonia to close Russia border after ‘sabotage’ bid, foreign minister says
item.description: Estonia said on Sunday it would close its border with Russia after stopping what it said was an attempted arson attack by Russia’s GRU military intelligence on a drone factory. “Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of 1 December,” Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna posted on social media, citing “clear evidence” that the GRU had ordered the attack. Earlier on Sunday, Prime Minister Kristen Michal wrote on social media that the GRU had ordered a “sabotage attempt” at the... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse

item.title: Más de 1.500 migrantes llegan a Canarias este fin de semana en una nueva crisis de la ruta atlántica
item.description: Más de 1.500 migrantes han llegado a las Islas Canarias durante este fin de semana, en una intensa sucesión de operaciones de rescate que ha situado a El Hierro en el epicentro de la presión migratoria. Solo el sábado fueron rescatadas al menos 1.488 personas, una cifra que posteriormente se elevó a 1.580 según los balances actualizados, en la mayor jornada de llegadas registrada en la historia reciente de la ruta atlántica. El repunte vuelve a poner a prueba los recursos de acogida del archipiélago y aumenta la presión sobre el Gobierno español para reforzar su respuesta. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Australia and Philippines sign new defence pact amid South China Sea tensions
item.description: The Philippines is building closer military ties with Australia, Japan and the US as tensions with China continue in the South China Sea. The partnerships cover joint exercises, surveillance equipment and closer coordination between their forces. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Israel kills senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza strike
item.description: The Israeli military said on Sunday its forces had killed a senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza. The militant group confirmed the death of Samir Abu Younis, the commander of its Rafah brigade, adding that he played a prominent role in planning the October 7, 2023 attacks. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Estonia cerrará su frontera con Rusia el 1 de diciembre tras un presunto acto de sabotaje
item.description: "Los intentos de intimidar, desestabilizar o socavar nuestra seguridad no quedarán sin respuesta", ha afirmado el ministro de Exteriores Leer Publicado también por: El País - Internacional. Fuente: El Mundo - Internacional.

item.title: Mysterious object in space: Could it be a Soviet probe missing for 40 years?
item.description: The object, known as "1998 KY26", about 11 metres wide, is moving near Earth; yet something other than the Sun's or Earth's gravity seems to affect its path and speed. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Los primeros ricos de Europa no heredaron la riqueza: se la ganaron (y tardaron siglos en hacerla hereditaria)
item.description: Echando la vista atrás desde la actualidad, resulta muy complicado saber quién era rico antaño, cuando no existía la escritura para dejar testimonio. Así que un equipo de investigación de la Universidad de Copenhague ha desarrollad o un método llamado QuantWealth que permite deducirlo a partir de las tumbas. Y han empezado probándolo en unas tumbas de Bohemia de hace 4.500 años. El hallazgo . Al aplicarlo a la cultura de la cerámica cordada han descubierto que la desigualdad en las comunidades de pastores de Centroeuropa fue creciendo lentamente a lo largo de los siglos y que quienes llegaban… Fuente: Xataka.
item.dc:creator: Eva R. de Luis

item.title: Cien días de De la Espriella en Colombia: entre la guerra al crimen y las redes sociales
item.description: Una guerra abierta contra el crimen organizado, un ambicioso plan de ajuste fiscal, una sintonía absoluta con Estados Unidos y hasta un terremoto que devastó medio país: los primeros cien días de Abelardo De la Espriella como presidente de Colombia han sido todo menos anodinos.Conocido como 'El tigre' , el presidente del país suramericano se propuso marcar un antes y un después a su llegada al poder, el pasado 7 de agosto, en la ciudad de Cali.Desde sus primeros días al frente de la 'Patria milagro', como él mismo define a su proyecto de país, De la Espriella decidió mover la sede del… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Milton Merlo

item.title: Italy fines Meta $887M for accessing Android users’ photos
item.description: Meta's Facebook app accessed users’ photos and videos on Android devices without “obtaining specific consent,” Italian authorities said. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: The Washington Post - World.
item.dc:creator: Victoria Bisset

item.title: En 2010 vimos una avispa rara en este idílico pueblo de Navarra. Hoy las velutinas ya ocupan el 18% de la España peninsular
item.description: Es 5 de enero de 2019. De noche. Un equipo baja un nido de avispas asiáticas de un sauce blanco en Nigrán (Pontevedra). Está a 12 metros del suelo y en él vivían 1979 avispas velutinas, sin contar los huevos . Era una colonia en plena producción . El único problema es que esa colonia debería de haber llevado semanas muerta: la velutina es un reloj. Los nidos se apagan entre noviembre y diciembre y solo las reinas pasan el invierno. En enero, en Pontevedra, esas avispas asiáticas no se habían ni enterado. Y esto explica mejor que nada la forma en la que esta especie invasora se ha hecho con… Fuente: Xataka.
item.dc:creator: Javier Jiménez

item.title: Lalit Modi announces he has acquired British citizenship; ‘proudly’ calls it home
item.description: Lalit Modi announced on X that he had been naturalised as a British citizen on September 20; says United Kingdom has been my home for many years Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: 'Record number of women elected' to US Congress & governorships across country in midterm elections
item.description: Following the 2026 US midterm elections, Gavin Lee is pleased to welcome Politico Senior National Politics Reporter Lauren Fedor. She discusses the growing number of Democratic women elected to Congress and governorships, particularly mothers of young children. “There was a realisation across the map that perhaps moms were the best messenger for this,” she explains, pointing to voters' concerns about “the cost of living, affordability, how to make ends meet.” Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Gavin LEE

item.title: McIlroy wins Race to Dubai after thrilling final day
item.description: Rory McIlroy takes second place at golf's DP World Tour Championship, finishing ahead of Spain's Eugenio Chacarra to secure the Race to Dubai title for a record-equalling eighth time. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Iran claims drone attack on US military base in Bahrain
item.description: Bahrain issued two alerts of potential threats on Sunday, its first such warnings since September as blasts rocked the capital, Manama. It comes after Iran targeted an airbase in the US-allied island state, ending a long lull in strikes during the Middle East War and comes as negotiations to end the conflict remain at a stalemate, with the US maintaining its naval blockade and Iran its stranglehold over the strait of Hormuz. Story by Rachael Griffiths. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Canaries urge government action after 2,200 migrants reach the islands in 48h
item.description: Spain says nearly 2,200 migrants have arrived by boat to the Canary Islands this weekend. The Spanish islands are one of the main entry points into Europe for migrants from Africa. The Spanish Interior Ministry says more than 13,000 arrived there between January and the end of last month. Details and analysis by Andrew Hilliar, FRANCE 24 international affairs editor. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Record number of migrants arrive in Spain’s Canary Islands
item.description: New EU migration and asylum laws have largely failed to stem flow of migrants to Spain and its territories. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Macron busca reforzar influencia francófona entre tensiones por posible reelección de secretaria general de la OIF
item.description: El presidente francés llegó a Camboya para participar en la cumbre de la Organización Internacional de la Francofonía (OIF), que aborda la diversidad lingüística en la inteligencia artificial, la cooperación económica y la elección de su próximo secretario general. Pero las tensiones vinculadas al conflicto en el este de la República Democrática del Congo han marcado el evento: Kinshasa retiró su candidatura, en medio de su rivalidad con Ruanda. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Maxime Pluvinet

item.title: Jensen Huang: The French Connection
item.description: President Trump is heading to Asia in a few days time, and will meet President Putin and President Xi. There's likely to be one fewer tech giants at the table, Jensen Huang, newly resigned from Nvidia, over the suspected spy affair. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Gavin LEE

item.title: Polish activists face opposition as they make abortion more accessible
item.description: Abortion laws in Poland are very restrictive. Activists there have found a new way to help women wanting to terminate a pregnancy: the "Abortomat," a locker that dispenses abortion pills. But they face fierce opposition. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: Santa school in full swing in London ahead of Christmas celebrations
item.description: It may still be November but it's beginning to look a lot like Christmas in South London, as many Santa impersonators are heading to school for their festive training. The school, organised by an event company called Ministry of Fun, brings together Santas, elves, and Mrs Clauses to share experiences, practice belly laughs and learn how to bring the magic of Christmas to life. Story by Rachael Griffiths. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: A deep dive into Ivory Coast's solar energy goals
item.description: Can Ivory Coast, which remains heavily dependent on fossil fuels, turn to solar power to make its energy consumption greener and more sustainable? We visited the country's new solar power plant in Ferkessédougou, in the north of the country. Inaugurated in July, it is expected to generate nearly 90 gigawatt-hours of electricity a year. Report by Julia Guggenheim. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Beavers reintroduced to an English estate changed its stream within a year
item.description: The Spains Hall Estate in Essex has welcomed the return of beavers, leading to remarkable improvements in the local ecosystem. A year after their reintroduction, studies revealed an increase in both the quantity and diversity of terrestrial invertebrates. Additionally, water quality enhancements were noted, with elevated oxygen levels and diminished nitrate concentrations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Why the Nvidia scandal is bad news for Europe’s AI ambitions
item.description: Nvidia's Jensen Huang poured money into open-source AI, from French-founded Hugging Face to chips for Mistral's data centres, and fought Washington's attempts to restrict it. With Huang gone and China hawks emboldened, Tech 24 asks whether Europe's AI ambitions have lost their most powerful ally, and whether he was ever the champion Europe needed. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Peter O'BRIEN

item.title: En directo: Irán afirma que atacó base militar de EE. UU. en Bahrein; fuerzas yemeníes se retiran de área clave en guerra con hutíes
item.description: La Guardia Revolucionaria de Irán aseguró este domingo 15 de noviembre que atacó un sistema de radar en una base de helicópteros estadounidense en Bahréin. Washington no se ha pronunciado al respecto. Entretanto, las fuerzas gubernamentales de Yemen se retiraron de una zona cercana al estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb para, sostienen, centrarse en la defensa de su base principal en Adén. Se trata de un duro revés en su ofensiva—respaldada por Arabia Saudita— contra los hutíes, alineados con Irán. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Francophonie summit opens in Cambodia overshadowed by African tensions
item.description: The 20th Francophonie Summit opened on Sunday in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, overshadowed by a high-stakes leadership dispute. The International Organisation of the Francophonie is set to elect its next secretary-general on Monday for a four-year term, but escalating friction between Rwanda, which has led the OIF for eight years, and the Democratic Republic of Congo has thrown the summit into crisis. Details by Liza Kaminov. Publicado también por: France 24 - English. Fuente: Africanews.
item.dc:creator: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)

item.title: US probes nationwide flights stoppage as travel disruptions persist
item.description: US air travel is expected to return to normal this Sunday, following a nationwide ground stop Friday night that stranded hundreds of thousands of passengers and disrupted travel worldwide. The Trump administration blamed the incident on a botched replacement of old copper wire communication lines and said there was no evidence this was a cyberattack. The ground stop now raises questions about the country's aging infrastructure and lawmakers are calling for an investigation. Analysis by Philip Mann, aviation expert at Vector Strategic Consulting. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Ueno Bank: ¿incendiaron una sucursal y apareció una bóveda secreta?
item.description: 🇵🇾 Paraguay atraviesa una profunda crisis bancaria tras la intervención de Ueno Bank por parte del Banco Central, dejando a millones de clientes sin acceso a sus depósitos y provocando protestas. El expresidente Santiago Peña, quien fue destituido por el Senado, se encuentra en prisión preventiva por acusaciones en su contra en relación al caso. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Tensiones en la Cumbre de la Francofonía por posible reelección de la secretaria general
item.description: La unidad de los países francófonos parece estar en juego en la Cumbre de la Francofonía que se desarrolla en Camboya. Con la posible reelección de la ruandesa Louise Mushikiwabo como secretaria general de la organización sobre la mesa, la República Democrática del Congo acusa a su vecino de acusar al grupo paramilitar M23 y busca evitar la reelección de Mushikiwabo, con otras delegaciones amenazando con retirarse de la organización si vuelve a ser reelegida. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Chinese spy, chip sales, Trump ties... The Nvidia scandal deepens
item.description: The Nvidia scandal continues to unravel. Sunday, the Singapore-based company Megaspeed said that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang had officially left the company in 2025. She is the alleged Chinese spy that had an affair with Nvidia's former CEO Jensen Huang. Late last year, revelations showed she was being investigated for chip smuggling. The scandal has also raised questions about how much the US government knew – Trump was allegedly warned about the affair but did not react. Analysis by Laïla Mörch, CEO of Shael and tech investor in Paris. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: The week in pictures: Spain protests, Pope Leo's Peru 'homecoming' and Rocky fans in Philly
item.description: FRANCE 24 looks back at some of the week's most striking images, from angry protests over a housing crisis that has dominated Spain's election campaign, to Leo XIV's visit to his adopted homeland Peru and "Rocky" fans marking 50 years since the release of boxing movie classic. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: French Ciryl Gane retains MMA heavyweaight title agianst Josh Hokit
item.description: Ciryl Gane remains the world's MMA heavyweight champion. Overnight, the French athlete beat Josh Hokit in the main event of UFC 334 at Madison Square Garden in ​New York. The 5-round fight was rough, as Shirli Sitbon explains. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Bahrain says air defences destroyed several Iranian drones attacking US base
item.description: Bahrain issued two alerts of potential threats on Sunday, its first such warnings since September. The second Iranian drone attack in three days, ending a long lull in strikes during the Middle East war. Diplomatic efforts to end the almost nine-month conflict have yet to produce a breakthrough, with ​sporadic attacks continuing. Details from the ground by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Tehran, Reza Sayah. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Germany vs Netherlands: Nations League – preview, team news, predictions
item.description: Germany will likely need to win on Monday to reach the quarterfinals unless Serbia beat Greece away from home. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: France's presidential race heats up
item.description: In approximately six months' time, French voters will head to the polls for the first round of the presidential election. Due to term limits, current president Emmanuel Macron is barred from running again. But that hasn't stopped a whole host of candidates from tossing their hat in the ring. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Starshield restrictions help Russia’s energy attacks on Ukraine: Zelenskyy
item.description: The Ukrainian President said Russia struck energy and railway infrastructure in eight regions overnight, with many strikes getting through because of limits on Starshield terminals Publicado también por: The Hindu - International. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russia's petrochemical capital in overnight assault
item.description: Russian officials confirmed Sunday that the central industrial city of Nizhnekamsk had endured "prolonged" Ukrainian airstrikes overnight, damaging a residential building and sparking a fire at a major petrochemical complex, injuring three people. Separate overnight strikes on Taganrog city killed an electricity substation engineer, according to the regional governor. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Europa ya sabe el precio de llenar sus costas con parques eólicos marinos: menos lluvias
item.description: En el objetivo de la UE de lograr la neutralidad climática para 2050, la energía eólica es un actor esencial para conseguirlo y dentro de los aerogeneradores hay un segmento que tiene un papel importante: la offshore. La Unión Europea aspira a disponer un aporte energético de 60 GW para 2030 y llegar a los 300 GW para 2050. Y si hay una región en la UE de la que esperan un aporte excepcional, esa es la del Mar del Norte: se ha comprometido a aportar al menos 260 GW. Pero hay un problema: alguien ha calculado qué pasaría con la lluvia si todo el espacio disponible del Mar del Norte y el… Fuente: Xataka.
item.dc:creator: Eva R. de Luis

item.title: León XIV cumplió promesa con Santa Cruz de Succhabamba y regresó para fiesta del Señor del Costado
item.description: El papa León XIV cumplió su promesa con los sacerdotes de Santa Cruz de Succhabamba. El sumo pontífice regresó a la localidad para la fiesta del Señor del Costado, patrón del pueblo, una conmemoración a la que asistía durante su tiempo como obispo. El jefe de la iglesia católica también visitó Zaña, una comunidad donde llegaban los esclavos de la época colonial y que actualmente cuenta con una gran comunidad afrodescendiente. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Nations grapple with loss of 1.5C target at UN climate summit
item.description: The world has already warmed about 1.4°C above pre-industrial times and the UN declared in September that crossing 1.5°C — the most ambitious target threshold of the Paris accord — was imminent and unavoidable Publicado también por: The Hindu - International. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Branthwaite, Garner and King omitted for Spain game
item.description: England manager Thomas Tuchel omits Josh King, James Garner and Jarrad Branthwaite from his squad to face Spain on Sunday night. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Wartime Kyiv turns to New York-style bagels for comfort
item.description: Models and diplomats flock to this cafe, where the owner, a veteran, says baking has given him a new mission after he was injured in the conflict with Russia. Fuente: The Washington Post - World.

item.title: En directo: el papa es recibido en Cusco para encuentro con miles de fieles en su penúltimo día de gira por Perú
item.description: En una intensa jornada, León XIV llega a Cusco y Pucallpa, en la selva del Amazonas de la zona este de Perú, antes de volver a Lima en la noche de este domingo 15 de noviembre. Se trata del penúltimo día de su primera gira por el país y la región, que lo llevó también a Uruguay y Argentina. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: "En Málaga podremos hacer cosas que en Bélgica están totalmente prohibidas": hablamos con Karel van Gils, director general de imec Spain
item.description: Imec ( Interuniversity Microelectronics Centre o Centro Interuniversitario de Microelectrónica) es el laboratorio de investigación especializado en el desarrollo de semiconductores avanzados más importante de Europa. Y uno de los más influyentes del planeta . Nació en 1984 en Lovaina (Bélgica), y algunos de los campos en los que desarrollan su actividad sus investigadores son el escalado de circuitos integrados, la integración de sistemas, la fotónica del silicio , la inteligencia artificial , los sensores o la conectividad. Más allá de su Bélgica de origen, actualmente este centro tiene… Fuente: Xataka.
item.dc:creator: Laura López

item.title: Chinese J-10C fighter spotted carrying modified Russian-origin heavy-strike missile
item.description: New state media footage has surfaced showing for the first time what appears to be a Chinese-modified variant of the Russian-origin Kh-29T air-to-surface missile mounted on a J-10C fighter jet. State broadcaster CCTV’s social media account posted a video on Wednesday featuring Chinese fighters, showing the missile mounted under the 4.5-generation fighter as it took off, according to posts by Chinese military bloggers over the weekend. China originally imported about 2,000 Kh-29T missiles... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Amber Wang

item.title: Seville European Film Festival Prizes: ‘You Don’t Belong Here,’ ‘Falling House,’ ’Adult Supervision’ Win Big
item.description: Romania’s Florin Şerban added a Seville Golden Giraldillo to a Golden Leopard at Locarno on Saturday, winning Best Film in main competition at the 2026 Seville European Film Festival which also prized Venice New Horizons buzz title “Falling House” and Sweden’s Oscar entry “Adult Supervision.” Seville’s biggest world premiere, Spain’s “The Director,” also scored a […] Fuente: Variety.

item.title: A disastrous Iran war? The US is now a mover and shaker of oil markets
item.description: Many see the US war on Iran as a colossal geopolitical bungle, failing to secure its larger strategic objectives. Yet it has allowed the blundering Trump administration to move into an immensely powerful position – one it seems ready to embrace. With its new-found sway over Venezuela’s oil reserves, degradation of Iranian exports and selective sanctions on Russian oil, Washington has unexpectedly acquired several important levers of the global petroleum trade. Iran has worked hard to play... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Peter Wynn Kirby

item.title: The Philippines and Australia strengthen joint military deterrence at ASEAN summit
item.description: Southeast Asian leaders opened their annual summit in the Philippine capital Manila on Sunday. During three days, world leaders are expected to focus on trade, energy and conflict – including the war in Iran. Donald Trump is expected to land in Manila on Tuesday. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Bangkok Tommy Walker. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Will Ukraine make territorial concessions for NATO membership?
item.description: The United States suggested Ukraine make territorial concessions in exchange for a NATO membership, according to Volodymyr Zelensky. The Ukrainian president also claims that Russia has rejected an energy truce. This week’s US-mediated negotiations did not result in any tangible progress. Story by Simon Moritz. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Air travel issues persist in the US after nationwide ground stop
item.description: After almost five hours of grounded flights in the US, flights have resumed. However, passengers are still waiting and wading through tough logistics to get to their destinations after massive delays and cancelled flights. Details by Simon Moritz. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Jordania condena a muerte a tres hombres acusados del letal ataque contra una iglesia
item.description: Este domingo 15 de noviembre, el Tribunal de Seguridad de Jordania condenó a muerte a tres hombres tras hallarlos culpables de perpetrar el letal atentado ocurrido contra una iglesia greco-ortodoxa el pasado octubre. El ataque, registrado en la gobernación de Karak, en el sur del país, dejó nueve personas muertas y decenas de heridos. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Putin's alleged grandson takes mother's name to avoid 'Zelensky' surname
item.description: The dancer shares a surname with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky but is not related to him. Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
item.dc:creator: BY JERUSALEM POST STAFF

item.title: Illegal mining threatens French Guiana forests and indigenous communities
item.description: In French Guiana, the fight against illegal gold mining is rapidly being lost and creating an environmental and health disaster, according to the World Wildlife Fund. During an aerial survey in early August, park rangers counted 239 illegal sites within the protected area in record. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Massachusetts man, 85, loses $1M in alleged fake Brazil farmland romance scam
item.description: An 85-year-old man sent over $1 million to a woman claiming she needed it for taxes and legal fees. Maria Auxiliadora Rezende allegedly fabricated a story concerning inherited farmland in Brazil. Family members noticed unusual transactions and investigated the situation after voicing concerns. Authorities arrested Rezende and she faces a federal indictment for wire fraud. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: Aman Xess

item.title: Madrid ya está saturado, así que el mercado de la vivienda se está disparando ahora en Torrejón, Parla y Alcorcón
